description: Fetches League of Legends China (lol.qq.com) news/article content by document ID, including title, author, publication date, view count, and full article content with images.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_article: 获取文章详情，需要 docid 参数; 参数: docid; 必填: docid

docid.description:
文章文档ID（数字字符串），或包含 docid 参数的完整URL。
例如: "10255542153636928057" 或 "https://lol.qq.com/news/detail_m.html?docid=10255542153636928057"
get_article 函数使用此参数。
